verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback widget captures user-submitted feedback, routes it to a project or org Feedback list, filters spam, and lets an agent turn a report into an intention/tasks — this supports triage but the evidence never shows enriched 'customer context' (e.g., user profile, account, usage data) surfaced alongside the feedback for prioritization. missing for 10: customer/account context data linked to feedback entries, prioritization/scoring views for a PM, independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
